# =============================================================================
# CurricuMap taxonomy: English Language Teaching (ELT) teacher education, YÖK
# =============================================================================
#
# SOURCE
#   Authored from the official YÖK (Turkish Council of Higher Education) ELT
#   undergraduate programme course lists ONLY: the 2018 programme (compulsory
#   courses plus its MB, GK and AE elective pools) and the 2006 programme
#   (compulsory courses), 158 titles (validation/data/yok_programmes.csv).
#   No institutional catalogue, transcript or registrar export was used.
#   Beyond stems of the official titles, the rules add only generic registrar
#   renderings: upper case, missing Turkish letters, Roman/Arabic numerals,
#   common abbreviations ("ÖĞR.", "EĞT.", "BEC.", "YAB."), and, for R4, the
#   language names under which a second foreign language is printed.
#
# DOMAIN CONVENTION (how each official title received its label)
#   R1  MB    teaching-profession knowledge (meslek bilgisi) -> pedagogy
#   R2  GK    general culture (genel kültür)                 -> general_ed
#   R3  AE/A  field courses, by subject matter -> language_skills,
#             linguistics, literature, or pedagogy (ELT methodology)
#   R4  second foreign language (İkinci Yabancı Dil)          -> general_ed
#
# SIZE   9 rules, 61 keywords, 36 regexes, 0 overrides.
# CHECK  158 source titles: 157 correct, 0 unmatched, 14 flagged ambiguous
#        (the compound titles described under RULE ORDER). The one miss is
#        unavoidable: the identical title "Türk Eğitim Tarihi" is MB
#        (pedagogy) in 2018 but GK (general_ed) in 2006; a title-level rule
#        cannot honour both, so this taxonomy follows the 2018 programme it is
#        named after.
#
# MATCHING
#   Titles are casefolded with Turkish rules (İ->i, I->ı) and whitespace is
#   collapsed. "any" keywords are substrings of that normalized title; "regex"
#   entries are Python regular expressions searched in it, written in lower
#   case. Keywords are word stems, so one keyword covers a course family
#   across suffixes and numerals: "dilbilim" matches "Dilbilim I",
#   "Dilbilimi 1" and "SOSYODİLBİLİM". Regexes add three things:
#     - exports without Turkish letters, via [iı] [öo] [üu] [şs] [çc] [gğ]
#       [âa]: an ASCII "INGILIZ" casefolds to "ıngılız", "Ogretim" to
#       "ogretim";
#     - word boundaries (\b) or a title-start anchor (^) where a bare stem
#       would be too broad;
#     - abbreviations that end in a full stop ("ÖĞR.", "DİL BEC.").
#   There is no catch-all: an off-programme title such as "Beden Eğitimi ve
#   Spor" matches nothing and is flagged for review.
#
# RULE ORDER (first matching rule wins; a title matched by rules of more than
# one domain is flagged ambiguous)
#   1 literature > 2 linguistics > 3-4 language skills > 5-7 pedagogy >
#   8-9 general education
#   - Subject before method. Many R3 titles attach a subject to "öğretimi"
#     (teaching of): "Dil ve Edebiyat Öğretimi" is literature, "Edimbilimi ve
#     Dil Öğretimi" linguistics, "İngilizce Dil Becerilerinin Öğretimi"
#     language skills. The subject rules therefore run before the generic
#     teaching stems of rule 5, and these compound titles are the expected
#     ambiguity flags.
#   - Literature and linguistics name an academic discipline and run before
#     the skill stems (okuma, yazma, çeviri), which could appear inside a
#     discipline's title.
#   - General education runs last and uses only distinctive stems, so a
#     pedagogy title that mentions a general subject ("Çocuklara Yabancı Dil
#     Öğretimi") stays in pedagogy.
# =============================================================================
taxonomy:
  id: elt_yok_2018
  label: "ELT Teacher Education Curriculum (YÖK 2018)"
  locale: { language: tr, casefold: locale-aware }
  domains:
    - { id: language_skills, label: "Language Skills" }
    - { id: pedagogy, label: "Pedagogy" }
    - { id: linguistics, label: "Linguistics" }
    - { id: literature, label: "Literature" }
    - { id: general_ed, label: "General Education" }
  match:
    strategy: ordered_rules
    fuzzy: { enabled: false, threshold: 0.9, scorer: token_set_ratio }
  rules:
    # 1 LITERATURE (R3). "edeb-" marks every literature title in both
    # programmes (İngiliz Edebiyatı, Dil ve Edebiyat Öğretimi, Edebiyat ve Dil
    # Öğretimi); the word-initial regex also covers "edebi", the dotless
    # "EDEBIYATI" and the abbreviation "EDEB.".
    - domain: literature
      any: ["edebiyat"]
      regex: ['\bedeb']

    # 2 LINGUISTICS (R3). The discipline names and the AE linguistics
    # electives. "dilbilim" also covers Sosyodilbilim and never matches
    # "dilbilgisi" (grammar, a language-skills course). "söylem" needs
    # whole-word boundaries so that "söyleme" (singing) is not caught.
    - domain: linguistics
      any: ["dilbilim", "edimbilim", "dil edinim", "dil ve toplum", "dünya ingilizce"]
      regex:
        - 'd[iı]l ?b[iı]l[iı]m'          # also the spaced "Dil Bilimi"
        - 'ed[iı]m ?b[iı]l[iı]m'
        - '\bs[öo]ylem\b'                # Söylem Çözümlemesi (discourse)
        - 'd[iı]l ed[iı]n[iı]m'
        - 'd[iı]l ve toplum'
        - 'd[üu]nya [iı]ng'              # also "DÜNYA İNG."

    # 3 LANGUAGE SKILLS (R3): the four skills. A bare "beceri" (skill) is
    # avoided because thinking-, study- or life-skills courses would match;
    # only language and expression skills ("dil/anlatım becerileri") count.
    - domain: language_skills
      any: ["okuma", "yazma", "dinleme", "sesletim", "sözlü iletişim", "dil beceri", "anlatım beceri"]
      regex:
        - 'd[iı]nleme|seslet'
        - 's[öo]zl[üu] [iı]let'          # also "SÖZLÜ İLET."
        - '\b(d[iı]l|anlat[ıi]m) bec'    # also "DİL BEC."

    # 4 LANGUAGE SKILLS (R3): grammar, vocabulary, translation and English in
    # use (İngilizcenin Yapısı, Kitle İletişiminde İngilizce). "dilbilgisi" and
    # "dil bilgisi" are grammar and never linguistics.
    - domain: language_skills
      any: ["dilbilgisi", "sözcük", "ingilizcenin yapı", "çeviri", "kitle iletişim"]
      regex:
        - 'd[iı]l ?b[iı]lg[iı]'
        - 's[öo]zc[üu]k'
        - '[iı]ng[iı]l[iı]zcen[iı]n yap'
        - '[çc]ev[iı]r[iı]'
        - 'k[iı]tle [iı]let'

    # 5 PEDAGOGY (R1, R3): teaching and learning. Every MB or ELT-method title
    # that names teaching (öğretim, öğretmenlik) or learning (öğrenme) and has
    # no subject from rules 1-4: Öğretim İlke ve Yöntemleri, Mikro Öğretim,
    # Öğretmenlik Uygulaması, İngilizce Öğretiminde ..., Çocuklara Yabancı Dil
    # Öğretimi, Açık ve Uzaktan Öğrenme, Öğrenme Güçlüğü, and so on.
    - domain: pedagogy
      any: ["öğretim", "öğretmen", "öğrenme"]
      regex:
        - '\b[öo][gğ]re[tn]'             # "OGRETIM", "ogrenme"
        - '\b[öo][gğ]r(t|et)?\.'         # "ÖĞR.", "ÖĞRT."

    # 6 PEDAGOGY (R1): education as a field of study. A bare "eğitim" is too
    # broad: "Beden Eğitimi ve Spor", "Müzik Eğitimi" and the GK course "İnsan
    # Hakları ve Demokrasi Eğitimi" are training in a subject, written as the
    # possessive compound "X Eğitimi". The first regex therefore accepts
    # "eğitim" only in its bare, dative, genitive or locative form ("Eğitim
    # Psikolojisi", "Eğitime Giriş", "Eğitimde Drama", "Türk Eğitim Tarihi",
    # "Özel / Kapsayıcı / Karşılaştırmalı Eğitim", "Kalkınma ve Eğitim"),
    # never "Eğitimi". The abbreviation "EĞT." is accepted only at the start of
    # a title, where it cannot be the possessive. The MB titles of the
    # "X Eğitimi" shape are reached through their learner group or setting:
    # children (Hastanede Yatan Çocukların Eğitimi, Çocuk Psikolojisi),
    # adults (Yetişkin Eğitimi), museums (Müze Eğitimi), values (Karakter ve
    # Değer Eğitimi).
    - domain: pedagogy
      any: ["çocuk", "yetişkin", "müze", "değer eğitim"]
      regex:
        - '\be[gğ][iı]t[iı]m(e|de|[iı]n|[iı]nde)?\b'
        - '^e[gğ][iı]?t\.'
        - '[çc]ocuk|yet[iı][şs]k[iı]n|\bm[üu]ze'
        - '(karakter|de[gğ]er(ler)?) e[gğ][iı]t[iı]m'

    # 7 PEDAGOGY (R1, R3): school and classroom, guidance, assessment, learner
    # psychology, thinking skills, special needs, materials and textbooks.
    # "sınıf" needs word boundaries (never "sınıflandırma"); "okul" is safe as
    # a stem (Okul Deneyimi, Okullarda Rehberlik, Okul Dışı Öğrenme Ortamları,
    # Türk Eğitim Sistemi ve Okul Yönetimi).
    - domain: pedagogy
      any: ["okul", "rehber", "ölçme", "değerlendir", "psikoloji", "düşünme", "hiperaktivite", "kaynaştırma", "materyal", "ders kitab", "ders içeriğ"]
      regex:
        - '\bs[ıi]n[ıi]f\b'              # Sınıf Yönetimi, Sınıf İçi ...
        - '\b[öo]l[çc](me|\.)|de[gğ]erlend[iı]r'
        - 'ps[iı]koloj|d[üu][şs][üu]nme|h[iı]peraktiv|kayna[şs]t[ıi]r'
        - '\bders (k[iı]tab|[iı][çc]er[iı])'

    # 8 GENERAL EDUCATION (R2, R4): the common compulsory courses. "Türkçe"
    # and "Yabancı Dil" are regex-only, with lookaheads, so that the
    # translation courses (İngilizce-Türkçe Çeviri) and the foreign-language
    # teaching courses (Yabancı Dil Öğretimi) are never candidates here. The
    # last regex is R4: a registrar often prints the second foreign language
    # under the language's own name instead of "İkinci Yabancı Dil".
    - domain: general_ed
      any: ["atatürk", "inkılap", "türk dili", "bilişim", "bilgisayar", "topluma hizmet"]
      regex:
        - 'atat[üu]rk|[iı]nk[iı]l[âa]p'
        - 't[üu]rk d[iı]l[iı]'
        - '\bt[üu]rk[çc]e\b(?!.*[çc]ev[iı]r)'
        - '\byab(anc[ıi]|\.) ?d[iı]l(?! [öo][gğ]r)'    # also "YAB. DİL"
        - 'b[iı]l[iı][şs][iı]m|b[iı]lg[iı]sayar'
        - 'topluma h[iı]zmet'
        - '\b(almanca|frans[ıi]zca|[iı]spanyolca|[iı]talyanca|rus[çc]a|arap[çc]a|japonca|[çc][iı]nce)\b'

    # 9 GENERAL EDUCATION (R2): the general-culture electives, one stem per
    # topic. "Bilim" is anchored to the start of the title (Bilim Tarihi ve
    # Felsefesi, Bilim ve Araştırma Etiği, Bilimsel Araştırma Yöntemleri)
    # because "bilim" also occurs inside "Dilbilimi" and "Eğitim Bilimine
    # Giriş". "Drama" is anchored because only the stand-alone 2006 GK course
    # is general education; "Eğitimde Drama" and "İngilizce Öğretiminde Drama"
    # are pedagogy.
    - domain: general_ed
      any: ["sanat", "kültür", "insan hak", "demokras", "insan ilişki", "etkili iletişim", "kariyer", "ekonom", "girişimci", "beslenme", "sağlık", "bağımlılık", "medya", "okuryazar", "mesleki ingilizce", "halk oyun", "musik", "işaret dili", "coğrafya"]
      regex:
        - '^b[iı]l[iı]m'
        - '^drama\b'
        - 'k[üu]lt[üu]r|[iı]nsan (hak|[iı]l[iı][şs]k)|etk[iı]l[iı] [iı]let|kar[iı]yer|g[iı]r[iı][şs][iı]mc'
        - 'sa[gğ]l[ıi][kğg]|ba[gğ][ıi]ml[ıi]l[ıi]k|meslek[iı] [iı]ng|[iı][şs]aret d[iı]l|co[gğ]rafya'

  # No overrides: every official title is reached by a general rule above.
  overrides: []
  defaults: { unmatched: flag }

# =============================================================================
# CurricuMap taxonomy: English Language Teaching (ELT) teacher education, YÖK
# =============================================================================
#
# SOURCE
#   Authored from the official YÖK (Turkish Council of Higher Education) ELT
#   undergraduate course lists ONLY: the 2018 programme (compulsory courses
#   and the MB, GK and AE elective pools) and the 2006 programme (compulsory
#   courses), 158 programme entries with 150 distinct titles
#   (validation/data/yok_programmes.csv). No institutional catalogue,
#   transcript or registrar export was used. Titles are expected in Turkish,
#   as in the YÖK lists; an English-titled export needs its own rules.
#   Every "any" keyword is a stem of an official title. The regexes add:
#     - renderings of those stems: upper case, no Turkish letters, Roman or
#       Arabic numerals, punctuation, and abbreviations ending in a full stop
#       (ÖĞR., ÖĞRT., EĞT., EĞİT., EDB., EDEB., DİLBİL., EDİMB., SOSYODİLB.,
#       SÖYL., DİL EDİN., DÜNYA İNG., BEC., SÖZL. İLET., SÖZC., SÖZ. BİLG.,
#       DİL BİLG., İNG., YAB., ÇOC., ÖLÇ., DERS KİT., HİPERAKT., DÜŞ., SAN.,
#       TOPLUMA HİZ.);
#     - eight common synonyms, marked "synonym": gramer, kelime, tercüme,
#       pragmatik, sosyolinguistik, konuşma, müzik, bilgi teknolojileri;
#     - for R4, a second foreign language printed under its own name, and
#       literatures in languages other than English.
#   A keyword is the readable form that provenance reports; the regexes of
#   the same rule cover its renderings. Keep plain, unambiguous keywords in
#   the FIRST rule of each domain: "curricumap synth" and the paper's
#   illustrative example name their synthetic courses after them.
#
# DOMAIN CONVENTION (how each official title received its label)
#   R1  MB    teaching-profession knowledge (meslek bilgisi) -> pedagogy
#   R2  GK    general culture (genel kültür)                 -> general_ed
#   R3  AE/A  field courses, by subject matter -> language_skills,
#             linguistics, literature, or pedagogy (ELT methodology)
#   R4  second foreign language (İkinci Yabancı Dil)          -> general_ed
#
# SIZE   9 rules, 60 keywords, 62 regexes, 0 overrides.
# CHECK  In-sample (the rules were written from these entries): 157 of 158
#        correct, 0 unmatched, 14 flagged ambiguous (13 subject + Öğretimi
#        titles and "Dünya İngilizceleri ve Kültür", see RULE ORDER).
#        Held-out results are reported in validation/. The one miss is
#        unavoidable: the identical title "Türk Eğitim Tarihi" is MB
#        (pedagogy) in 2018 but GK (general_ed) in 2006. A title-level rule
#        cannot honour both, so this file follows 2018; for a 2006 cohort add
#        the override { course: "Türk Eğitim Tarihi", domain: general_ed }.
#
# MATCHING
#   Titles are casefolded with Turkish rules (İ->i, I->ı) and whitespace is
#   collapsed. "any" keywords are substrings of that normalized title, so a
#   stem covers a course family: "dilbilim" matches "Dilbilim I", "Dilbilimi
#   1" and "SOSYODİLBİLİM". "regex" entries are Python regular expressions
#   searched in the normalized title, written in lower case:
#     [iı] [öo] [üu] [şs] [çc] [gğ]  a Turkish letter or its ASCII stand-in
#                                    ("INGILIZ" folds to "ıngılız")
#     \b  a word boundary           ^  the start of the title
#     (?!x)  not followed by x      (?<!x)  not preceded by x
#   There is no catch-all: a title that matches nothing ("Beden Eğitimi ve
#   Spor", "Hızlı Okuma Teknikleri", "Makine Öğrenmesi") is flagged
#   unmatched for review.
#
# RULE ORDER (first matching rule wins; a title matched by rules of more than
# one domain is flagged ambiguous)
#   1 general ed. (languages) > 2 literature > 3 linguistics >
#   4-5 language skills > 6-8 pedagogy > 9 general ed. (other GK)
#   Two precedences decide official titles:
#   - Subject before method (rules 2-5 before rule 6): 13 entries join a
#     subject to "Öğretimi" (teaching of): Dil ve Edebiyat / Edebiyat ve Dil
#     Öğretimi (literature, 4 entries), Edimbilimi / Sosyodilbilim / Söylem
#     Çözümlemesi ve Dil Öğretimi (linguistics, 3), (İngilizce / Tümleşik)
#     Dil Becerilerinin Öğretimi and İngilizce Sözcük Bilgisi Öğretimi
#     (language skills, 6). They are the expected ambiguity flags. Assessing
#     a skill follows the same convention: "Dil Becerilerinin
#     Değerlendirilmesi" is language skills, flagged.
#   - Linguistics before rule 9: "kültür" would otherwise take "Dünya
#     İngilizceleri ve Kültür".
#   Rule 1 decides no official title. It runs first so that a course in
#   Turkish or in a second foreign language stays general education whatever
#   its subject ("Almanca Dilbilgisi", "Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı", "Rus
#   Edebiyatı", all flagged). Lookaheads, not order, keep the translation
#   courses and the foreign-language teaching courses out of rule 1. The
#   remaining orders (literature > linguistics > skills, pedagogy > rule 9)
#   change no official title; they settle unofficial compounds such as
#   "Edebiyat ve Çeviri" or "Bilgisayar Destekli Dil Öğretimi".
# =============================================================================
taxonomy:
  id: elt_yok_2018
  label: "ELT Teacher Education Curriculum (YÖK 2018)"
  locale: { language: tr, casefold: locale-aware }
  domains:
    - { id: language_skills, label: "Language Skills" }
    - { id: pedagogy, label: "Pedagogy" }
    - { id: linguistics, label: "Linguistics" }
    - { id: literature, label: "Literature" }
    - { id: general_ed, label: "General Education" }
  match:
    strategy: ordered_rules
    fuzzy: { enabled: false, threshold: 0.9, scorer: token_set_ratio }
  rules:
    # 1 GENERAL EDUCATION (R2, R4): the common compulsory courses and every
    # course in a language other than English.
    - domain: general_ed
      any:
        - atatürk                  # Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılap Tarihi 1, 2 / I, II
        - inkılap
        - türk dili                # Türk Dili 1, 2
      regex:
        - 'atat[üu]rk|[iı]nk[iı]l[âa]p'
        - '\bt[üu]rk d[iı]l'       # TURK DILI; also Türk Dilbilgisi, Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı
        # Türkçe I: Yazılı Anlatım, Türkçe II: Sözlü Anlatım. Not when the
        # title also names English, translation (çev-, tercüm-) or teaching:
        # İngilizce-Türkçe Çeviri belongs to rule 5.
        - '^(?!.*(\b[iı]ng|[çc]ev|terc[üu]m|[öo][gğ]ret)).*\bt[üu]rk[çc]e'
        # Yabancı Dil 1, İkinci Yabancı Dil I, "YAB. DİL II", "Yabancı Dil
        # (Almanca) I": at most one word before it, and only a numeral, a
        # bracket, a colon, a dash or nothing after it. So "Çocuklara Yabancı
        # Dil Öğretimi" and "Yabancı Dil Eğitimi" never match here.
        - '^(\S+ )?yab(anc[ıi]|\.) ?d[iı]l(\s*[-–:(]|\s+([ıiv]+|\d+)\b|\s*\d|$)'
        # R4: the second foreign language printed under its own name.
        - '\b(almanca|frans[ıi]zca|[iı]spanyolca|[iı]talyanca|rus[çc]a|arap[çc]a|japonca|[çc][iı]nce|korece|fars[çc]a|yunanca|lat[iı]nce)\b'
        # Literature in another language (Türk / Alman Dili ve Edebiyatı).
        - '\b(alman|frans[ıi]z|rus|[iı]spanyol|[iı]talyan|arap|fars|japon|[çc][iı]n|t[üu]rk|d[iı]van|halk) (d[iı]l[iı] ve )?edeb'

    # 2 LITERATURE (R3): İngiliz Edebiyatı, Dil ve Edebiyat Öğretimi, Edebiyat
    # ve Dil Öğretimi.
    - domain: literature
      any:
        - edebiyat
      regex:
        - '\bedeb(?![iı]l)'        # EDEBIYAT, edebi, EDEB.; not the verb "edebil-" (İfade Edebilme)
        - '\bedb\.'                # EDB.

    # 3 LINGUISTICS (R3): the discipline and the AE linguistics electives.
    - domain: linguistics
      any:
        - dilbilim                 # Dilbilimi 1, Dilbilim I, Sosyodilbilim ve Dil Öğretimi
        - edimbilim                # Edimbilimi ve Dil Öğretimi
        - dil edinim               # Dil Edinimi
        - dil ve toplum            # Dil ve Toplum
        - dünya ingilizce          # Dünya İngilizceleri ve Kültür
      regex:
        - 'd[iı]l ?b[iı]l([iı]m|\.)'      # DILBILIMI, Dil Bilimi, DİLBİL.; never dilbilgisi (grammar)
        - '\bed[iı]m ?b'                  # EDİMB., EDİM BİL.
        - 'sosyo ?(d[iı]l|l[iıe]ng)'      # SOSYODİLB.; synonym: Sosyolinguistik
        - 'pragmat[iı]k'                  # synonym of edimbilim
        - '\bs[öo]yl(em\b|\.)'            # Söylem Çözümlemesi, SÖYL.; whole word, so not "söyleme"
        - 'd[iı]l ed[iı]n'                # DIL EDINIMI, DİL EDİN.
        - 'd[iı]l ve toplum'
        - 'd[üu]nya [iı]ng'               # DÜNYA İNG.

    # 4 LANGUAGE SKILLS (R3): the four skills. Okuma, yazma, dinleme and
    # konuşma (synonym for the official sözlü iletişim) count only at the
    # start of the title or of a segment after ". : ) -", alone or after
    # İleri, Eleştirel, Akademik, Yaratıcı, Temel or İngilizce, as in every
    # official title. So "Hızlı Okuma", "Proje Yazma", "Nota Okuma",
    # "Okuma Güçlüğü" and "Müzik Dinleme Kültürü" are not skills courses.
    - domain: language_skills
      any:
        - sesletim                 # Dinleme ve Sesletim 1, 2 / I, II
        - sözlü iletişim           # Sözlü İletişim Becerileri 1, 2 / I, II
        - dil beceri               # (İngilizce / Tümleşik) Dil Becerilerinin Öğretimi
        - anlatım beceri           # Anlatım Becerileri
      regex:
        - '(^|[.:)\-–] )(([iı]ler[iı]( d[üu]zey)?|ele[şs]t[iı]rel|akadem[iı]k|yarat[ıi]c[ıi]|temel|[iı]ng[iı]l[iı]zce|[iı]ng\.) )?(okuma|yazma|d[iı]nleme|konu[şs]ma)\b(?!.*(g[üu][çc]l|k[üu]lt[üu]r|bozuk))'
        - 'sesl(et|\.)'                   # SESLETIM, SESL.
        - '\bs[öo]z(l[üu]|l?\.) ?[iı]l(et|t\.)'   # SOZLU ILETISIM, SÖZL. İLET., SÖZLÜ İLT.
        - '\b(d[iı]l|anlat[ıi]m) bec'     # DİL BEC., ANLATIM BEC.

    # 5 LANGUAGE SKILLS (R3): grammar, vocabulary, translation and English in
    # use. "dilbilgisi" is grammar, never linguistics.
    - domain: language_skills
      any:
        - dilbilgisi               # Bağlamsal Dilbilgisi I, II
        - sözcük                   # Sözcük Bilgisi, İngilizce Sözcük Bilgisi Öğretimi
        - çeviri                   # Çeviri, İngilizce-Türkçe / Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri
        - ingilizcenin yapı        # İngilizcenin Yapısı
      regex:
        - 'd[iı]l ?b[iı]lg(?![iı]sa)'     # DIL BILGISI, DİL BİLG.; not "Dil Bilgisayar"
        - 'gramer'                        # synonym of dilbilgisi
        - '\bs[öo]z(c|\. ?b[iı]lg)'       # SÖZC., SÖZ. BİLG.
        - 'kel[iı]me b[iı]l'              # synonym: Kelime Bilgisi
        - '[çc]ev[iı]r[iı]'               # CEVIRI
        - 'terc[üu]me'                    # synonym of çeviri
        # Translation by its language pair, so an abbreviated "ÇEV." or a
        # truncated title still lands here.
        - '[iı]ng(\.|[iı]l[iı]zce)\W*t[üu]rk[çc]e|t[üu]rk[çc]e\W*[iı]ng(\.|[iı]l[iı]zce)'
        # İngilizce'nin Yapısı (any apostrophe), İNG. YAPISI; İngiliz Dilinin Yapısı.
        - '[iı]ng(\.|[iı]l[iı]z)\S*( n[iı]n| d[iı]l[iı]n[iı]n)? ?yap'
        # Kitle İletişiminde İngilizce: English in the media, so English must
        # follow; "Kitle İletişim Araçları" is not an ELT course.
        - 'k[iı]tle [iı]let\S*\s+[iı]ng'

    # 6 PEDAGOGY (R1, R3): teaching and learning, once rules 1-5 have claimed
    # the titles with a subject. Öğretim İlke ve Yöntemleri, Mikro Öğretim,
    # Öğretmenlik Uygulaması, İngilizce Öğretiminde ..., Çocuklara Yabancı
    # Dil Öğretimi, Açık ve Uzaktan Öğrenme, Öğrenme Güçlüğü, and so on.
    # "öğrenme" is regex-only so that "Makine Öğrenmesi" and "Derin Öğrenme"
    # stay out; "öğrenci" (student) is not a stem.
    - domain: pedagogy
      any:
        - öğretim
        - öğretmen
      regex:
        - '(?<!mak[iı]ne )(?<!der[iı]n )\b[öo][gğ]re(t[iı]m|tme|nme)'   # OGRETIM, ogrenme
        - '\b[öo][gğ]r[^\s.]{0,4}\.'      # ÖĞR., ÖĞRT., ÖĞRET., ÖĞRTM.

    # 7 PEDAGOGY (R1): education as a field of study, and learner groups.
    # A bare "eğitim" is too broad: "Beden Eğitimi ve Spor", "Müzik Eğitimi"
    # and the GK "İnsan Hakları ve Demokrasi Eğitimi" are training in a
    # subject, written with the possessive "X Eğitimi". So "eğitim" counts
    # only bare or as -e, -de, -in (Eğitim Psikolojisi, Eğitime Giriş,
    # Eğitimde Drama, Türk Eğitim Tarihi, Özel / Kapsayıcı / Karşılaştırmalı
